output.summary: Herbaceous perennial native to Asia from the Caucasus through the Himalayas to China, Japan and Korea. Its orange-red flowers open successively and each lasts only one day. Flowers, young leaves, shoots and tubers are edible, though leaves and shoots should be eaten very young before becoming fibrous.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers and young tubers may be eaten raw or cooked; leaves and shoots are eaten raw or cooked only while very young.
